Select the ChEMBL ID, name, max phase, type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL2069259. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by doc chembl_id. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
